summary: Software engineer who builds enterprise-grade APIs and platform features end-to-end — Node.js/TypeScript services, React UIs, PostgreSQL data models and AWS infrastructure. Built Refill Arena from zero to $1M+ revenue across 3,200+ brands and 190+ countries, owning the relational schema, scalable APIs and third-party data integrations. Comfortable moving between API development, UI/UX and data-integration work as priorities shift, with strong SQL/analytical skills and a bias for ownership.

Integrated multiple third-party data suppliers and built internal tools that cut manual operations work.
Improved backend performance **25%** via query optimization and caching; built JWT auth and Stripe subscription flows.
Delivered features independently from requirements through deployment, working async with US stakeholders.
